literal: And love and virtue if possesses domestic life, and quality and fruit that.
translation: If domestic life possesses love and virtue, that is both its true character and its ultimate fruit.
modern: குடும்ப வாழ்க்கை அன்பையும் அறத்தையும் கொண்டதாக இருக்குமானால், அதுவே அவ்வாழ்க்கையின் பண்பும் பயனும் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essence and purpose of a householder's life. If a family life is built upon love among its members and virtue towards the world, it achieves its true state. Here, love represents the internal quality or character of the home, while virtue represents the external fruit or benefit it yields to society. Thus, love and virtue are not just ornaments but the very definition and reward of domestic life.
